why_next: This packet is a valid MEASUREMENT_INVALID outcome, and it is the most useful Graph packet in the current cycle precisely because it separates two things the previous two packets fused. The producer did not overclaim: result.json reports status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID and outcome=INCONCLUSIVE, the audit concurs with status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID and producer_claim_supported=false, and the control-level label 'FALSIFIED_ON_ITS_OWN_TERMS' is annotated in the packet itself as not the packet status. The fatal defect is V9_CODE_HASHED_INTO_FREEZE, and I verified its cause in the control plane rather than accepting it: scripts/freeze_experiment.py builds its freeze payload from request.json, spec.json and prereg.md only, and check_scope.py restricts DESIGN to spec.json, prereg.md, failure.json and model_design.json, so outcome-bearing code cannot exist at freeze time in ANY lane and no compliant execution of this design was ever possible. That is a control-plane capability gap, not a lane failure and not a scientific result, and it is the second consecutive Graph packet lost to design or control-plane defects rather than to substrate. But the packet is not empty: the measurements it refused to discard show that the selection signal is real and separable (paraphrase 19/20 for the embedding route against 15/20 for the lexical null; 45/52 for the uncalibrated argmax reference; 52/52 for the oracle, so the ceiling is reachable), that the exact 0.0 pooled tie with the lexical null is a cancellation of +4, -5 and +1 rather than equivalence, and that the fitted applicability gate passed its own fittedness test while firing on 0 of 52 applicable goals, so every abstention in the packet came from a non-calibrated slot filler and the 11-of-20 confident wrong executions on goals with no applicable mechanism were invisible to every frozen gate. The next question is therefore not a re-ask with better plumbing: it changes the object of study from 'can this gate beat a lexical null' to the joint selection-and-safety problem of whether a gate fitted with a genuine negative class can be non-inert and hold its safety bounds at acceptable coverage, with abstention measured as a first-class outcome, with one unambiguous false-accept definition that counts the failure the current suite is blind to, with a binding headroom screen on the correct denominator, with a reference arm declared non-empty in advance because the incumbent kernel provably cannot serve, and with code bound to the freeze through a mechanism the deterministic freezer can actually honour. It is freezable in one pass and it is built to fail loudly: if the gate cannot be made to fire on both classes, the preregistered dynamic-range precondition kills the packet before any candidate is scored. continue=false for two reasons that are not scientific: the repairs are design- and control-plane-level, so this must be a NEW experiment with a fresh Global Research Director mandate (AGENTS.md global direction discipline; EXPERIMENT_PACKET.md section 2) which the Graph lane cannot self-authorize, and the control plane must first decide whether the freezer will hash declared code. Both are named in dependencies and in recommended_action.

CONTROL-PLANE FACT, verified by the Director by reading the scripts rather than accepting the packet's account: scripts/freeze_experiment.py constructs freeze.json from exactly three files (request.json, spec.json, prereg.md) and contains no code-hashing branch, and scripts/check_scope.py's DESIGN policy permits writing only {exp}/spec.json, {exp}/prereg.md, {exp}/failure.json and {exp}/model_design.json. Consequence, and it is a programme-level risk rather than a Graph-lane detail: any validity condition of the form 'outcome-bearing code is hashed into freeze.json' is unsatisfiable by construction in every lane, and any experiment that freezes one is MEASUREMENT_INVALID before its first measurement. The Global Research Director's own mandate for this experiment required exactly that condition, so the mandate and the control plane are jointly responsible for the outcome. Smallest in-lane alternative, verified available: the freezer does hash prereg.md, and research/harness is already in the graph lane's allowed_code_roots (though the directory does not yet exist on disk), so a digest of a pre-existing committed harness module declared inside prereg.md binds the code to the freeze transitively and EXECUTE can recompute it and fail validity on mismatch.

PACKET INTEGRITY HELD, and independently re-verified by the Director rather than taken from the producer: all 19 artifact sha256 values in result.json.artifacts match the files on disk, the three frozen-input digests in freeze.json match, raw_evidence/task_results.jsonl holds exactly 480 well-formed rows (80 tasks x 6 arms, each arm present on every task), all 80 tasks began from a single identical application state hash (89172fde...), 78 distinct arm orderings were observed against a frozen minimum of 43, and no estimator dropped a row. Two independent full executions produced byte-identical raw and derived evidence. This is evidence the packet was transmitted honestly; it is not evidence that its numbers measure the frozen construct.

SELECTION-SIGNAL DECOMPOSITION, the packet's main scientific content, and every figure below was recomputed by the Director directly from the 480 raw rows, not copied from result.json or the audit. On the 52 goals with at least one applicable mechanism: A-CANDIDATE 36/52, B-LEXICAL-OVERLAP 36/52 (difference exactly 0.0, one-sided lower 95% -0.0652, p=0.5943), A-REFERENCE-EMBEDARGMAX 45/52, B-INTERNAL-ID-ORACLE 52/52, B-RANDOM-ROLE 7/52, A-INCUMBENT 0/52. Per category: verbatim 12/12 for all three non-trivial arms; paraphrased 19/20 candidate against 15/20 lexical and 19/20 argmax; underspecified 0/10 candidate against 5/10 lexical and 9/10 argmax; composite 5/10 candidate against 4/10 lexical and 5/10 argmax. Contingency candidate versus lexical: 29 both correct, 7 candidate-only, 7 lexical-only, 9 neither. The candidate's correct set is a strict subset of the argmax reference's: 36 shared, 0 candidate-only, 9 argmax-only. Scope of the statement: one 20-mechanism bound-slot fixture, one embedding model, one run, no cross-model replication.

THE POOLED TIE IS A CANCELLATION, NOT EQUIVALENCE. The 0.0 difference decomposes into +4 on unseen paraphrase, -5 on goals that omit a required parameter and +1 on composite goals. On paraphrase - the unseen-goal generalization test the registry next_gate actually names - the semantic route is ahead of lexical overlap 19/20 to 15/20, and on composite it is ahead 5/10 to 4/10. The tie is produced entirely by the underspecified category, where declining to answer is scored as an error by the frozen metric (prereg.md 6.1). UNRES-03 is therefore partially resolved in the direction that lexical at 36/52 is not a semantic ceiling.

THE FITTED GATE WAS INERT. p_applicable spans [0.6785, 0.9468] over the applicable goals, the selected threshold is 0.02, and 0 of 52 goals fall below it. All 28 candidate abstentions carry abstain_reason 'unfilled_parameter_slots'. The gate is formally fitted and passes V4's letter (w=2.6927, b=0.1853, w_spread 1.1230 across independent refits, so it is not a fixed algebraic transform), but it made no decisions: every abstention in the packet was produced by a non-calibrated keyword slot filler. A post-hoc diagnostic that maximised ACCEPT-class F1 instead of the frozen commit/abstain F1 also selected 0.02, and every threshold in (0.02, 0.68] would abstain on 0 of 52 goals, so inertness is a property of the fitted coefficients on a positive-only label set rather than of the threshold-selection rule.

A SAFETY BLIND SPOT IN THE FROZEN METRIC SUITE, verified by the Director from the raw rows: on the 20 'ood' goals, which have no applicable mechanism at all, the candidate produced 11 EXECUTABLE decisions at p between 0.6925 and 0.8407 (mean 0.7787) and abstained on 9. Those wrong executions carry no weight in the primary metric (applicable-only denominator), no weight in the false-accept numerator under reading R1, and no weight in either ECE gate (the gate was fitted only on goals that have an applicable mechanism). No frozen gate can see confident execution against a mechanism that does not exist. This is a metric-suite gap, not an implementation bug, and it is the most product-relevant observation in the packet.

THE FALSE-ACCEPT DENOMINATOR IS AMBIGUOUS IN THE FROZEN TEXT and the coded value is a hybrid: reading R4 (all-80 wrong executions over the 52 applicable goals) for A-CANDIDATE and reading R2 (all-80 over all 80) for every other arm. The candidate's cell is the only hybrid cell and the most pessimistic one. Under R1 the candidate scores 0.0962 and PASSES while the lexical null scores 0.3077 and fails; under R2 (0.2000), R3 (0.1220) and R4 (0.3077) the candidate fails. It is the only gate whose verdict is interpretation-dependent, and the producer disclosed it after seeing the outcomes and correctly did not repair it. Consequence: the false-accept column is not comparable across arms and no cross-arm false-accept statement may be made from this packet.

V8(a) IS STRUCTURALLY NON-BINDING, established from the raw rows: B-LEXICAL-OVERLAP never abstains, so all 28 goals with no applicable mechanism are scored incorrect by construction and its accuracy on the frozen 80-goal set is capped at 52/80 = 0.65 for any lexical selector whatsoever, below the 0.90 headroom threshold. The screen therefore passes by arithmetic rather than by evidence, and the null it was written to police is in fact strong: applicable-only accuracy 0.6923, including 12/12 verbatim and 15/20 paraphrase. The previous packet's screen failure mode (a null that reaches ceiling) has been replaced by its mirror image (a screen that cannot fail), which is not an improvement in identification.

KERNEL CONSTRAINT, second independent confirmation with a different cause from the parent packet. A-INCUMBENT produced 0 of 80 EXECUTABLE and 80 UNKNOWN. Director read of src/spider/kernel.py at the execution base commit 7f5879fc: resolve() requires exact intent-string equality (line 97) AND every slot in set(m.parameter_slots) | _template_slots(action_template) to be present in the supplied params (lines 104-106), skipping the mechanism otherwise. This packet's V11 fixture deliberately gives every mechanism a non-empty parameter_slots and the incumbent adapter supplies params={}, so no mechanism can ever become a candidate. The leg is therefore empty on ANY fixture that requires bound parameter slots, which is the opposite fixture shape from the parent's, and prereg.md 4.2's expectation that the incumbent's mechanisms carry parameter_slots=[] contradicts V11 inside the same frozen document. Also re-confirmed: distill() emits confidence=0.5 with no parameter_slots (lines 74-91), min_confidence defaults to 0.8 (line 59) and line 114 returns EXPLORE below it, so EXECUTABLE is unreachable at the default configuration; and a repository grep for 'def distill_parameterized' and 'def align_parameters' under src/ returns zero matches on a 132-line file. Scope: the kernel at this commit only.

CONTROLS, with their caveats. PC-VERBATIM-INTENT met its decision gate (mechanism-identity accuracy 1.0 on a denominator of 12, zero false accepts, zero abstentions) and missed its descriptive expectation ECE=0.0 at 0.0532, because all 12 verbatim rows sit at cos=1.0 which the fitted gate maps to p=0.9468 rather than 1.0; its UNKNOWN precision of 1.0 is vacuous because the arm never abstains there. NC-NO-APPLICABLE abstained on 8 of 8 with zero false accepts, but for the wrong reason: all 8 abstentions came from the slot filler and the calibrated gate abstained on 0 of them. B-INTERNAL-ID-ORACLE reached 52/52 on applicable goals and abstained on all 28 no-applicable goals, so the declared difficulty ceiling is reachable and the candidate's 36/52 is a real gap to a reachable ceiling rather than an artifact of an unsolvable fixture. B-RANDOM-ROLE at 7/52 = 0.1346 is BELOW the 0.2 chance level implied by 5 mechanisms per role, because its role-keyword table sometimes picks the wrong role and sometimes none.

MEASUREMENT SUBSTRATE DEFECTS FROM THE PARENT PACKET ARE REPAIRED, as operational state and explicitly not as evidence about the claim: byte-reproducible across two independent executions with all five seeds fixed and logged (goals 36279237023, arm order 20260926, split 990017, random-role 4242, bootstrap 36279237023); per-task state reset implemented and verified by a single state hash across all 80 tasks; 78 distinct arm orderings against a frozen minimum of 43; and the ECE and UNKNOWN-precision estimators unit-tested as an executed V5/V6 precondition, with the test confirming that a single abstention on an applicable goal scores 0.0 and therefore that the metric is not an OOD abstention rate. The parent's unseeded uuid4, its missing per-task state hash and its algebraic calibration head are all gone.

BOUNDED NEGATIVE, at the architecture level and explicitly below the claim ceiling, adopting the audit's claim_ceiling: on this 20-mechanism bound-slot fixture, a fitted logistic gate over embedding cosine combined with a generic keyword slot filler does not exceed a lexical-overlap null on mechanism-identity binding accuracy, and loses to the same embedding signal used without any gate. That bounds this resolver configuration. It does not bound semantic resolution, does not close C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE, and does not license retiring semantic resolution in favour of explicit goal annotation or full re-exploration.
rejected: REJECTED INTERPRETATION (this packet): that C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE is falsified, that its regime is closed, or that semantic resolution should be retired as an architectural component in favour of explicit goal annotation or full re-exploration. The pre-declared falsifier in spec.json.falsifier and prereg.md section 2 was NOT validly triggered: the frozen gate order short-circuits at gate 1 on V9, the audit sets the claim ceiling at HYPOTHESIS, and VALIDATED would require a PASS audit while REJECTED would assert a global refutation the audit explicitly declines. This rejects the interpretation, not the mechanism; the domain remains open.

REJECTED AS A CLEAN NEGATIVE ABOUT SEMANTIC RESOLUTION: reading the primary gate failure as 'semantic resolution is no better than lexical overlap'. The pooled difference is exactly 0.0 because +4 on paraphrase, -5 on underspecified and +1 on composite cancel, and the paraphrase and composite categories both favour the semantic route. The apparent null is produced by a metric that scores abstention as an error, entangled with the very component under test. Nothing in this packet licenses the conclusion the design's own falsifier would have required.

REJECTED AS EVIDENCE ABOUT THE FITTED GATE'S CALIBRATION: ece_global 0.2030, ece_per_class_max 0.7885 (ABSTAIN class 0.7885 over 11 rows, EXECUTABLE class 0.1319 over 41) and unknown_precision 0.6071 (17 TP / 11 FP) as measurements of the candidate's decision rule, and any statement that learned abstention cannot be calibrated. The gate fired on 0 rows; these numbers score an uncalibrated slot filler's abstentions against a gate confidence the gate never acted on. UNKNOWN precision here is, at least, a genuine precision over abstentions verified by unit test and not the substituted OOD abstention rate the parent packet used.

REJECTED AS COMPARABLE ACROSS ARMS: the false_accept_rate column. The candidate's cell is reading R4 and every other arm's is R2, so 0.3077 (candidate) against 0.55 (lexical) is not a comparison. Also rejected: any quoted false-accept rate without its reading stated, and any false-accept economics, cost or amortization claim derived from this packet.

REJECTED AS A PASSING SCREEN: V8(a) DEGENERACY SCREEN pass=true. It cannot fail on this fixture: the null never abstains, so 28 of 80 goals are scored incorrect by construction and the ceiling is 52/80 = 0.65 against a 0.90 threshold. Its pass is arithmetic, not evidence that the lexical null is weak - the null in fact binds 36/52 including 15/20 paraphrase.

REJECTED AS A MEASURED BASELINE OR FLOOR: A-INCUMBENT's 0 EXECUTABLE, and any primary-gate condition that treats it as a comparison. It is a code-level certainty on any fixture requiring bound parameter slots (kernel.py lines 97 and 104-106 read by the Director), not a low score, and the frozen prereg's own expectation for this arm contradicts its own V11 condition.

REJECTED AS THE ANSWER OR A PRODUCT CANDIDATE: A-REFERENCE-EMBEDARGMAX at 45/52. It is a legitimately non-empty reference (80/80 EXECUTABLE) and it is the single most decision-relevant comparison in the packet, but it never abstains and it executes on all 20 no-applicable goals (0.4375 as coded). It is a ceiling on what the embedding signal alone provides, not a shippable resolver, and it must not be promoted or treated as the answer.

REJECTED AS PRODUCT CONSEQUENCES IN EITHER DIRECTION: spec.json.product_consequence_positive (C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE advances to EXPERIMENTAL and unblocks C-LLM-INHERIT, C-CROSSSITE, C-PRODUCT-ECON), which is not triggered because gate 1 failed before the primary gate; and the report's and spec's framing of those claims as blocked or unblocked, which is not authorized. C-LLM-INHERIT, C-CROSSSITE and C-PRODUCT-ECON stand exactly where they stood (codex latest: MEASUREMENT_INVALID, HYPOTHESIS, HYPOTHESIS).

REJECTED AS APPLICABLE-GOAL ARITHMETIC: prereg.md 3.3's '60 applicable'. The frozen goal file yields 52 goals with an applicable mechanism (12 verbatim + 20 paraphrased + 10 underspecified + 10 composite) and 28 without (20 ood + 8 no_applicable); the 60 figure counts the 20 ood goals as applicable and contradicts the prereg's own OOD description and its own NC-NO-APPLICABLE control. REJECTED AS A CLAIM STATUS EVENT: the producer's control-level label controls['A-CANDIDATE'].verdict='FALSIFIED_ON_ITS_OWN_TERMS'. The packet itself annotates that it is not the packet's status, and it licenses no claim update, no narrowing and no product consequence.

unknown: Whether the candidate loses to the uncalibrated argmax because of the embedding or purely because of its non-calibrated abstention policy (result.json UNRES-01). The entire deficit sits in the 10 underspecified goals where the candidate scores 0/10 by abstaining and argmax scores 9/10, while on paraphrase and composite the two tie at 19/20 and 5/10. The frozen design contains no arm that separates selection from deferral, so this cannot be answered here.

Whether an applicability gate fitted with a genuine negative class would abstain on the no-applicable goals where this one fires on 11 of 20 (UNRES-02). Not testable in this packet: the fitting set contained only goals that have an applicable mechanism (28 goals excluded from fitting), so the gate never saw a negative and could not have learned to abstain on one.

Whether the targets 0.15 ECE / 0.85 UNKNOWN precision / 0.10 false-accept are reachable by any abstaining design on a fixture of this class (audit unresolved 2). The current failure is entangled with inertness rather than with a demonstrated impossibility: every threshold in (0.02, 0.68] abstains on 0 of 52 goals given the fitted coefficients, and a non-inert gate has never been measured here. Whether those thresholds are the right targets is a design question, not a tuning question.

Whether the lexical null at 36/52 is a genuine barrier to the semantic route or an artifact of this registry's shared resource nouns (UNRES-03, partially resolved in favour of 'not a barrier': the semantic route leads 19/20 to 15/20 on unseen paraphrase). What remains open is whether the paraphrase advantage survives a different registry, a different paraphrase distribution, a different embedding model or a held-out test split - none of which was run.

Whether the V9 failure is a documentation defect only, or means the executed code cannot be tied to any reviewed artifact (UNRES-04). Bounded as far as the packet allows: I recomputed all 19 artifact digests and all 3 frozen-input digests and all match, and provenance records the execution base commit 7f5879fc39eab2cd0d5c4da844547dea4976c807, so the code that produced the evidence is identifiable; but no code digest was bound before the freeze, so pre-registration could not have detected a substitution.

What the canonical applicable-goal count should be for any future design, and whether goals that omit a required parameter should be treated as a distinct deferral class rather than as errors (UNRES-06 plus validity note VN-12). 52 is used and justified here; the prereg's 60 is not defensible; the metric convention that turns a deferral into an error is a choice, not a fact.

Whether the fitted coefficients (w 2.6927, b 0.1853) and the p range [0.6785, 0.9468] are properties of this fixture or of the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 checkpoint. Single model, no ensemble, no cross-model replication, no held-out test split (the primary metric is reported on the union of train and validation: 0.6667 on the 42 train goals and 0.80 on the 10 validation goals), one embedding snapshot fingerprint, one run, five bootstrap blocks resampled as blocks only so the interval does not propagate goal-sampling or seed variability (VN-03, VN-04, VN-10).

Whether the Global Research Director and the control plane will extend the deterministic freezer to hash declared code artifacts. If they will not, then no lane can ever freeze a code-binding validity condition and every such experiment is invalid by construction - a programme-level question this packet cannot answer and must not be answered by a lane.

Whether the inherited-mechanism-harm question that the mandate explicitly deferred (does an inherited mechanism create new failure modes, such as a stale fragment forcing a wrong path or a mis-binding cascading) is now reachable. It presupposes an executable inherited arm, and this packet reinforces rather than relieves that obstacle: the committed kernel returned UNKNOWN on 80 of 80 goals on a fixture built for the purpose.
do_not_assume: Do not read decision MEASUREMENT_INVALID, audit status MEASUREMENT_INVALID, producer_claim_supported=false, or the producer's control label FALSIFIED_ON_ITS_OWN_TERMS as a scientific negative about C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE. The pre-declared falsifier was NOT validly triggered, no architectural component is retired, and C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE stays at its registry ceiling of HYPOTHESIS. The domain is open; this packet is bounded evidence about one resolver configuration on one fixture.

Do not cite mechanism_identity_accuracy 0.6923 as 'semantic resolution accuracy', as a refutation, or as a weak positive. It is one resolver configuration (fitted logistic gate over embedding cosine plus a generic keyword slot filler) on one 20-mechanism bound-slot fixture with 52 applicable goals, one embedding model, one run, no cross-model replication, and an abstention policy entangled with the score.

Do not cite ece_global 0.2030, ece_per_class_max 0.7885 or unknown_precision 0.6071 as evidence that learned abstention cannot be calibrated or that calibrated abstention is unattainable. The gate fired on 0 of 52 applicable goals; these are the slot filler's numbers. Equally, do not cite the observed ECE of 0.1319 on EXECUTABLE-only rows as a pass - its bootstrap upper bound is 0.2208, above the frozen 0.18 ceiling.

Do not compare the false_accept_rate column across arms and do not quote 0.3077 as the candidate's false-accept rate without naming the reading. The coded value is R4 for the candidate and R2 for every other arm; under R1 the candidate passes 0.10 and the lexical null fails it. No false-accept economics, cost or amortization claim may be drawn from this packet.

Do not treat the V8(a) degeneracy screen PASS as evidence that the lexical null is weak, and do not treat the previous packet's screen failure as repaired. Lexical overlap binds 36/52 including 12/12 verbatim and 15/20 paraphrase; the screen passes only because 28 of 80 goals cannot be answered by a non-abstaining selector, capping it at 0.65. The next screen must be computed on applicable goals.

Do not treat A-INCUMBENT's 0/80 as a measured baseline, a reference floor, or a control that happened to come out low, and do not reintroduce it as a comparison leg. It is a code certainty on any fixture requiring bound parameter slots, because kernel.py resolve() requires exact intent equality and every parameter slot in the supplied params, and the arm supplies params={}. Declare a substitute reference arm in advance instead.

Do not treat A-REFERENCE-EMBEDARGMAX's 45/52 as a candidate product resolver, a recommended architecture, or a ceiling on the claim. It never abstains, it executes on all 20 no-applicable goals, and it beats the candidate only because the frozen metric scores abstention as an error.

Do not generalize this packet in either direction. It says nothing about resolution on the live Web, about cross-site resolution, about real agent goals, about multi-step or multi-intent goals beyond one 20-goal composite category, about registries larger than 20 mechanisms, about adversarial or underspecified input at scale, or about LLM-based resolution. There is no LLM, no browser, no authentication, no pagination, no failure injection, no drift and no external site anywhere in the substrate (VN-02).

Do not treat my recomputation from the 480 raw rows, or the audit's recomputed_metrics, as corrected versions of the frozen metrics. result.json.metrics stand exactly as reported; the recomputation confirms them and adds nothing to the gate table. Downstream stages may challenge upstream evidence but may not rewrite it, and no file in this packet may be edited.

Do not re-execute or lightly re-freeze this design. A re-freeze that adds code hashes would repair V9 and change nothing else: the gate would still be inert, the false-accept denominator still ambiguous, the no-applicable wrong executions still invisible, and the abstention metric still entangled with the primary score. Two consecutive Graph packets have now been lost to design- or control-plane defects rather than to substrate; a third identical attempt would be a failure of direction discipline, not of effort.

Do not freeze any validity condition of the form 'code hashed into freeze.json' until the control plane changes. scripts/freeze_experiment.py can never satisfy it and DESIGN cannot create the code in time. The in-lane alternative is a digest declared inside prereg.md, which freeze.json does hash, pointing at a module that already exists under an allowed code root, with EXECUTE recomputing it and failing validity on mismatch. research/harness is already an allowed root for graph but does not yet exist on disk.

Do not reinstate the parent handoff's question. Its seven repairs were implemented here except the one the control plane cannot satisfy, and this cycle's director_mandate recorded an explicit opportunity cost: the inherited-mechanism-harm question was knowingly deferred because it presupposes an executable inherited arm. Do not silently re-import either question as if it were still this lane's mandate.

Do not wait on Runtime's 4-worker ledger, the Chromium CDP certification, any model key, any external host, or Product's kernel recovery. The claim is stdlib-only, fully offline, and measurable now; this packet's failure was packet construction and control-plane capability, not substrate.

Do not treat the artifact hash match, the byte-level reproducibility, the single state hash, the 78 arm orderings, the executed estimator unit tests, the 52/52 oracle, the 12/12 positive control or the 8/8 null control as support for the claim.
